deltas.behavior_text: sbx-ask answers every guest line in its sandbox room without an @mention (answer_unaddressed, default true); mention-only remains configurable

the sandbox knowledge bundle excludes internal working papers (docs/superpowers, docs/specs, docs/plans) and loads README, CLAUDE.md, top-level docs, then reference within a 48k-char budget — the 400 KB alphabetical fill made first answers 82 s
every sandbox session (guest or approved preview) auto-joins guest_mode.sandbox.room (default #general) — guests cannot /join, so this is how they reach the agent
guests (and approved users in sandbox preview) may only run /help /who /me /read and chat; other commands get 403 before IRC; per-guest+IP message rate limit returns 429
GET /consent serves the entry card so a guest with an outdated consent renews it by re-running the flow
